peopleNamesHint: Enter the name in Arabic, in English, or both.
recordHistoryHint: Every change to this record, who made it and when.
studentAccountHintCell: How this student signs in to the school's app.
studentChangeGradeHint: The student moves to the new grade from today. The earlier placement stays in the enrolment history.
studentGradeHint: The grade for this school year. Leave it for a student not placed yet.
studentMatchesOtherSchool: At another school of the group
studentPlacementHistoryHint: The student's grade in each school year at this school.
validationNameRequired: Enter the name in Arabic or English
personNoRoles: No current role at this school.
personNoContacts: No phone, email or address recorded.
personAccountHint: How this person signs in to the school's app.
personAccountNone: This person can't sign in until an account is linked.
staffCaption: Staff at this school with their roles, job titles and contact details.
staffSearchHint: Search staff by name, email or phone
staffEmptyBody: Teachers, office staff and leaders appear here once they hold a role at this school.
staffContactHint: The school reaches this person here. The email is also how they are found when added again.
staffGroupRoles: Also holds across the school group: {roles}. Change these from the group.
staffMatchesTitle: This email or phone already belongs to someone recorded.
staffMatchesSaveAgain: If this is someone else, save again to add them as a new person.
errorConflictVersion: Someone else changed this record while you were editing. Reload to see their changes, then try again.

errorSubjectCodeTaken: Another subject already uses this code. Choose a different code.

errorRelationshipSelf: A student cannot be their own guardian. Choose someone else, or add a new person.

errorAccessAssignmentOverlapping: This person already has this role for some of these dates. Choose other dates, or end the role they have first.
errorBirthDateTooEarly: Enter a date of birth from 1900 onwards.
errorSchoolYearMissing: There is no school year to place the student in. Add the year and its dates first.
errorTenantReadOnly: Your school's records are being moved, so changes cannot be saved for a few minutes. Try again shortly.
errorDatabaseBusy: The system is busy right now. Wait a moment, then try again.
errorReferenceGone: Something this refers to is no longer available. Reload the page and try again.
errorInvalidGeneric: Some of what you entered cannot be saved. Check the form and try again.
errorNotFoundRecord: This is no longer here, or you cannot open it.
errorForbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
errorSignedOut: Your session has ended. Sign in again to continue.
errorTooLarge: This is too large to send.
errorNetwork: The server could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
errorValidationRequired: Something the form needs is missing. Fill in every required field, then try again.
errorValidationInvalid: Something you entered cannot be accepted. Check your answers, then try again.
lrnErrReading: This lesson is no longer offered in that language. Reload the lesson to see the languages it has.
lrnErrShareUnsent: Hand in your project before you show it to the class.
courseworkErrNoDeclaration: This work no longer asks for a declaration. Reload to see where it stands.
courseworkErrNotAssessed: This work is no longer assessed coursework. Reload to see where it stands.
attErrCheckInOff: This way of checking in is turned off. Ask your teacher to mark you in.
gradingErrScaleUnknown: That grading scale is no longer in use. Reload to see the current list.
gradingErrProgrammeUnknown: That programme is no longer offered. Reload to see the current list.
fileErrUploadAgain: The upload did not finish. Upload the file again.
projectPageNeeded: A project needs a page or a program. Keep one file whose name ends in .html or .py.
itkErrFee: Enter the amount with no more than two decimal places.
errorPhoneInvalid: This phone number can't be read. Use the local format or include the country code.
signInPasswordChanged: {name}'s password is changed and their open sessions are signed out
signInCreateHint: Set a login and a first password, then share them with this person in person or through the school's usual channel.
signInSendLinkHint: We will email this person a link to choose their own password. It works once, within {days} days, and nobody else ever sees the password.
signInSendResetHint: We will email this person a link to choose a new password, keeping their sign-in name. It works once, within {days} days.
signInLinkSent: A sign-in link is on its way to {name}
signInChangeHint: Leave the password empty to keep the current one. A new password signs this person out everywhere.
signInLoginTaken: Someone at this school already signs in with this login.
signInPasswordHint: At least {count} characters. A short phrase is easier to remember than symbols.
signInDisableBody: {name} is signed out everywhere and cannot sign in until the sign-in is enabled again. Their record stays as it is.
capAccessManage: Manage roles and who holds them
capYearsManage: Set up school years and calendars
capLibraryReview: Review what teachers share to the school library
skillsObserveHint: Something you saw the student do, with no question asked: a discussion, a practical, a performance. It counts as one sitting toward their skills, and they and their family read it there.
skillsObserveNotePlaceholder: Explained in their own words how a plant uses light.
skillsSittingsHint: Each lesson, quiz attempt, graded rubric and observation it was worked out from, latest first. The latest counts most.
skillsHow: Worked out from marked answers to tagged questions, rubric levels on tagged criteria and teachers' observations, with recent sittings counting most. Secure means 80% or more, shown on at least two sittings.
curriculumMapHint: Which items of a framework the year's unit plans take up, unit by unit, and which none does yet.
curriculumMapNone: No unit takes it up yet
curriculumMapUnitNone: Its plan names nothing from this framework.
curriculumMapSummary: {covered} of {total} taken up across {units} units this year.
curriculumMapNoFrameworksBody: Add the school's frameworks, or the IB's key concepts and global contexts, under Standards. Unit plans then name them and the map reads them across the year.
curriculumMapNoUnitsBody: Modules of the school year show here once teachers write them.
standardsAssessed: Work is assessed against its items
standardsAssessedHint: Clear it for ideas that frame units rather than being assessed, such as key concepts or global contexts. Unit plans then name them without asking for questions on them.
standardsAddIbConcepts: Add the IB's key concepts and contexts
standardsIbConceptsAdded: Added the MYP's key concepts and global contexts, and the PYP's key concepts and themes
standardsFieldUnknown: A standard the school no longer has
skillsEmptyBody: Tag questions in this class's lessons and quizzes, or rubric criteria, with standards. Each marked answer and graded criterion then counts here.
skillsStudentEmptyBody: Once this student answers questions tagged with standards, their progress on each shows here.
goalsHow: Judge each child from everything you know of them, not from one piece of work: expected if they meet the goal, emerging if they are not there yet.
goalsNoteHint: What you have seen that the judgement rests on. Saved when you leave the box.
goalsEmptyTitle: No goals to judge against yet
goalsEmptyAdd: Add the EYFS early learning goals in one step, or build your own framework under Standards.
goalsEmptyAsk: Whoever keeps your school's standards adds the goals children are judged against.
goalsAddEyfs: Add the EYFS early learning goals
goalsFromAnswerHint: If this answer settles where the child stands, judge it here. The judgement keeps a link to this answer.
goalsExemptFrom: Exemption applies: {name} is exempt from this goal
goalsExemptHint: Only for a child with an individual exemption on religious or philosophical grounds. A child who was absent or ill, or who has special needs, is judged emerging instead. The return codes an exemption as A.
goalsReportSharedWith: Families of {count} of {total} children see this report, shared {when}
goalsReportSharedDone: Families can now read this report.
goalsReportWithdrawn: Families no longer see this report.
goalsReportFamilyHint: Your child's teacher judges where they stand on each goal from everything they know of them: expected if they meet it, emerging if they are not there yet.
goalsReturnHint: A transfer file (CTF) for your local authority with each child's seventeen early learning goals, from the judgements here. A child's ministry number is taken as their UPN.
goalsReturnGaps: Children whose records need more before the authority accepts the file: {count}
standardsHint: The frameworks your school teaches to, and the standards in each.
standardsEmptyBody: Add the school's own framework, or import one published in CASE, such as Common Core from the CASE Network.
standardsFrameworkTitleHint: As teachers know it, such as "IB MYP Sciences objectives" or "Common Core Mathematics".
standardsFrameworkEmpty: This framework has no standards yet.
standardsCaseHint: Choose a CASE package saved as JSON, as CASE editors and the CASE Network export it. Importing it again later updates the same framework, and tags on its standards stay.
standardsCaseUnreadable: This file isn't a CASE package. Export the framework as a CASE JSON package and try again.
standardsCodeHint: The publisher's code, such as 7.EE.B.4 or Criterion A.
standardsItemTypeHint: What the framework calls it, such as strand, objective or standard.
standardsUnderHint: Leave empty to put it at the top of the framework.
standardsRemoveBody: "{standard}" and every standard under it will be removed. Questions tagged with them stop showing those tags.
standardsRemoveFrameworkBody: "{framework}" and all its standards will be removed. Questions tagged with them stop showing those tags.
accessBuiltinOverrideHint: Changes here apply to this school only. Other schools keep the group's version of this role.
errorAccessLastManager: Someone must still be able to manage roles. Give another person that access first.
errorAccessNotHeld: You can only give access you hold yourself.
errorAccountSelf: You can't change your own sign-in here.
accessAssignHint: Only roles that give nothing beyond your own access are listed.
accessReplacesBuiltin: Use instead of their usual role's access
accessReplacesBuiltinHint: For narrowing one person, such as a teacher who should not see grades. Without it, this role adds to what they already have.
accessEndsOnHint: Leave empty for no end date.
accessEndAssignmentBody: {name} loses what this role gives from today. Their other roles stay.
accessAssignedRolesHint: Roles given on top of, or instead of, what their staff role brings.
accessNoAssignments: No roles assigned. Their staff role decides their access.
accessHeldHere: What they can do at this school
accessHeldHereHint: From their staff roles and assigned roles, as of today.
settingsSchoolIdentifierHint: The number the ministry or authority gives the school.
settingsDefaultLanguageHint: What people see before they choose a language themselves, and the language the school's website is written in first.
settingsWeekStart: First day of the school week
errorWeekStartWeekend: The school week can't start on a weekend day.
settingsNoWorkingYear: No school year covers today. Set one up so enrolment and registers have a year to use.
settingsWorkingYearHint: The school year in use today. Its dates and terms change on the school years page.
healthHint: Allergies, conditions and what to do. Only staff who hold health records see this, and each visit is recorded.
healthRemoveBody: It stops showing on the student's record. The change is kept in the history.
healthReportIntro: A doctor's letter, a test result or a care plan for {record}. It is stored encrypted for the school, and only the health staff open it unless you share it with the family.
healthReportFileHint: A PDF, a Word document, a photo or a scan.
healthReportShareHint: Guardians who may read the medical summary can open it.
healthReportSharedDone: The family can now open the report
healthReportUnsharedDone: The family can no longer open the report
healthReportRemoveBody: The file is deleted. The health record stays as it is.
healthDetailsHint: For example the allergy, the condition or the blood group.
healthActionPlanHint: What staff should do if it happens at school.
healthAlert: Show a medical alert on the student's record
healthAlertHint: Staff see the alert without the details, so they know to ask the office.
arrangementsHint: What this student is given in timed quizzes, in questions and for due dates. Quizzes and due dates apply it for them, so their teachers need do nothing.
arrangementsExtraTimeHint: Added to the time limit of every timed quiz.
arrangementsExtensionHint: Added to the due date of work they are set from now on, and of work still to come due. A date a teacher sets for them stands.
arrangementsReadAloudHint: Questions and their choices can be read aloud by the browser.
arrangementsFewerChoicesHint: A choice question in a quiz with two or more wrong options shows one fewer.
arrangementsRestBreaksHint: In a timed quiz the student may stop the clock to rest, their questions hidden, and take it up again. Their teacher sees each break.
demographicsHint: Nationality, birthplace, religion and home languages. Each visit is recorded.
demographicsNationalityHint: Up to four, for dual nationality.
custodyHint: Who may collect the student and what each guardian may see. Each visit is recorded.
custodyRightsHint: Full unless a court order says otherwise.
custodyIsolatedHint: They get their own thread with staff, and their phone and email are hidden from the student's other guardians.
custodyRestrictionsHint: For example: may not collect the student.
classesCaption: Classes of the school year with their class teacher, students and subjects.
classesClassTeacherHint: Looks after the class as a whole. Subject teachers are set below.
classesCodeHint: Short and unique in the year, for example 7-A. Letters, digits, dots, dashes.
classesEmptyBody: Add the year's classes, then place students in them from here or from each student's record.
classesEmptyTitle: No classes in this year yet
classesNoneTaughtBody: Classes you teach or assist in appear here once the school assigns you to them.
classesNoStudents: No students in this class on this day.
classesNoSubjects: No subjects taught to this class yet.
classesOwnRoster: This subject class has its own students rather than a class's.
classesSearchHint: Search classes by name or code
classesSubjectsHint: Each subject becomes a class of its own, with the same students and its own teacher.
classesSubjectTwice: Each subject can be added once.
classesTaughtCaption: Classes you teach this year with your role and their students.
classesLessonSoundsHint: Ticks and chimes as children answer. Read and recorded words still play.
enrolmentClassesHint: Each class the student has been in, with its dates. Moves keep the old class on record.
enrolmentFromHint: The first day in the new class. The old class ends the day before.
enrolmentMoveSummary: From {date} the student is in {class}; the current class ends the day before.
enrolmentStudentHint: Search by name. A student already in a class moves from the chosen day.
enrolmentWithdrawHint: The student keeps the days already spent in the class; from this day they are not in it.
validationClassCode: Use 1 to 40 Latin letters, digits, dots or dashes.
errorStandardsMove: A standard cannot go under one of the standards beneath it.
errorStandardsCaseTitle: This CASE package has no title, so it cannot become a framework.
errorStandardsFrameworkExists: This CASE framework is already here. Import it again from its own page to update it.
errorStandardsExists: This CASE package lists one of its standards twice.
errorStandardsEvidence: That answer was being marked at the same moment. Try again.
errorStandardsJudgement: Someone judged this child against the goal just now. Reload to see their judgement.
errorStandardsReport: Someone shared this report just now. Reload to see it.
errorLibraryReviewed: Another reviewer has already decided on it.
errorLibraryNotOwner: Only its owner or a library reviewer can take it out of the library.
errorLearningAudience: Each chosen group and student must belong to the class they are chosen in, once.
errorClassCodeTaken: Another class this year already uses this code.
errorSchoolYearClosed: This school year is closed, so it can't be changed.
errorFuturePlacement: The student already has a class starting later this year. Change that one first.
errorEnrollmentOutsideYear: The date must be within the school year.
yearsTermIncomplete: Give each term a name and both dates, the last on or after the first.
yearsAddHint: A new year starts as upcoming. Making it current is a separate step.
yearsLastDayHint: The school year is known by the calendar year it ends in.
yearsLastDayFixed: The last day stays in {year}, the calendar year this school year ends in.
yearsTermsHint: Terms divide the year for reports and grading. They sit inside the year and do not overlap.
yearsMakeCurrentBody: Lists, classes and registers open on {name} from now on. {current} closes and becomes read-only; it can be reopened for corrections.
yearsMakeCurrentFirstBody: Lists, classes and registers open on {name} from now on.
yearsCloseBody: A closed year is read-only: its classes, enrolments and records can be read but not changed.
yearsReopenBody: Reopening lets staff correct {name}. It does not become the current year, and the reason stays in its history.
yearsReasonRequired: Say why the year is being reopened.
yearsReasonHint: For example, a mistyped grade to correct.
yearsHint: Each school year with its dates, terms and status. One year is current at a time.
yearsCaption: School years with their dates, status, terms, classes and students.
yearsEmptyBody: Add the year the school is teaching, then its terms.
errorYearOverlapping: These dates overlap another school year.
errorYearEndFixed: The last day must stay in the calendar year this school year ends in.
errorYearRowsOutside: Students or classes have dates outside the new dates. Move or end them first.
errorYearCurrentClosing: The current year closes when another year is made current.
errorYearTransition: The year can't take that step from where it stands.
rolloverLeftOut: Left out: this class does not continue.
rolloverCodeTaken: The new year already has a class with the code {code}.
rolloverClassName: Every class that continues needs a name.
rolloverDuplicateCode: Two new classes have the same code.
rolloverTargetForLeaver: A student who leaves or graduates cannot have a new class.
rolloverSourceNotStarted: Roll over from a year that has started.
rolloverExists: A rollover between these years already exists. Reload to open it.

match.countPlural=one: {count} subject carries over with its teacher.
match.countPlural=*: {count} subjects carry over with their teachers.

courseworkAudienceRequired: Choose at least one group or student.
courseworkAvailableHint: Leave empty to show it as soon as it is assigned.
courseworkCaption: Coursework in your classes with its status, due date and progress.
courseworkClosesHint: Late work is accepted until then.
courseworkSharedNone: Nothing shared yet. Teachers share pieces of work they want you to see.
courseworkDueHint: On the school's clock. Leave empty for work with no due date.
courseworkEmptyBody: Assignments you set appear here as they move from draft to graded.
courseworkFamilyHint: Your child's missing work first, then what is due this week, what waits to be marked and what was returned.
courseworkFeedbackHint: The student reads this once the work is returned.
courseworkCommentsHint: Select a passage in the work to comment on it. The student reads comments once the work is returned.
courseworkCommentParagraphHint: Choose a paragraph instead of selecting its words.
courseworkCommentPlaceholder: What should the student notice here?
courseworkCommentMissing: This passage is no longer shown in the work.
courseworkBankEmpty: Nothing kept yet. Tick “Keep in my comment bank” when you write a comment.
courseworkBankShare: Share with teachers at the school
courseworkVoiceFeedbackHint: Record up to 3 minutes. The student hears it once the work is returned.
voiceRefused: The microphone is blocked. Allow it in the browser to record.
errorCourseworkCommentAuthor: Only the teacher who wrote a comment can change it.
courseworkHandedInHint: Your work is with your teacher.
courseworkHandInBody: Your teacher sees exactly what you hand in now. You can take it back until they start grading.
courseworkHandInBodyAgain: Your teacher sees exactly what you hand in now. If they return it, you can hand in again.
courseworkHint: Assignments in the classes you teach, from draft to returned.
courseworkLateAccept: Accept late work and mark it late
courseworkLateDeduct: Accept late work with a deduction
courseworkNoChildrenBody: The school links your children to your account.
courseworkNoRecipientsBody: Students appear here once the work is assigned.
courseworkNothingToReviewBody: Work students hand in waits here until you return it.
courseworkPointsFromRubric: The rubric's levels add up to this.
courseworkPointsRequired: Enter the points this work is out of.
courseworkResubmission: Students may hand in again after it is returned
courseworkGradeAfterAnswers: Show the grade after the comments are answered
courseworkGradeAfterAnswersHint: Students read your comments first; their grade appears once they have answered every one.
courseworkGradeHeldStudent: Your grade appears once you have answered every comment.
courseworkGradeHeld: Grade held until the comments are answered
rubricSheetHint: Each criterion is one thing the work is judged on. The grader picks a level for each, and the levels' points add up to the grade. Students read what the level they reached looks like.
rubricLevelDescriptionPlaceholder: What work at this level looks like (optional)
rubricStandardsHint: The level given here counts toward each standard in the student's skills, once the grade is returned.
rubricKeepChanges: Save the changes to “{title}” in my rubrics
rubricKeepHint: To use it again on other work.
rubricNameNeeded: Name the rubric to keep it.
rubricForgotten: Removed from your rubrics. Work using it keeps its copy.
courseworkScoreFromRubric: Filled in from the rubric; you can change it.
courseworkToDoHint: Work set for you, by the day it is due.
courseworkToReviewCaption: Assignments with handed-in work waiting to be returned.
courseworkToReviewHint: Work handed in and not yet returned, across your classes.
courseworkWorkCaption: Each student's standing on this assignment.
courseworkFilesInAnswerHint: Write here, and add files, photos or recordings from the toolbar or by dropping them in.
courseworkYourWorkHint: Save as you go, then hand in when you are ready.
courseworkErrQuizIncomplete: A question in this quiz is not finished yet.
courseworkExtendHint: On the school's clock. Leave empty to give back the assignment's due date.
errorCourseworkNotAssigned: Assign the work before giving a student their own due date.
courseworkNotSavedTitle: Not saved until it has a title
courseworkNotSavedQuestions: Not saved until the questions are finished
courseworkNotSavedDetails: Not saved until the details are fixed
courseworkShownNow: Students see it as soon as you assign it.
courseworkLateAcceptSentence: Late work is accepted and marked late.
courseworkLateDeductUntilSentence: Late work loses {percent}% and is accepted until {date}.
courseworkArchiveBody: Students no longer see it. Their work and grades are kept.
gradebookCaption: Each student's results and term grade.
gradebookHint: Results of the class's work and the term grades families see once released.
gradebookUnreleased: Some grades are not released yet.
gradesFamilyHint: Term grades once the school releases them.
gradesHint: Your term grades once your teachers release them.
gradesNoneBody: Term grades appear here once they are released.
errorCourseworkClosed: This work can't be handed in now.
errorCourseworkNothingToHandIn: Write something or attach a file before handing in.
errorCourseworkCannotUndo: This work is already being graded, so it can't be taken back.
errorCourseworkRubricTotal: The points must match the rubric's total.
errorCourseworkTooManyFiles: Too many files for this assignment.
errorFileNotAttachable: A file isn't ready or can't be attached here.
errorGradebookNotInClass: A student is not in this class.
errorScoreRange: The score is more than this work allows.
courseworkReturnedHint: Your teacher returned this work; the result is under Handed in.
courseworkExcusedHint: You are excused from this work.
attClosedYear: This school year is closed, so its registers can no longer change.
attFutureDay: A register can be taken today or for an earlier day.
attOutsideWindow: This day is past the window in which teachers can change registers. Ask the attendance office to correct it.
attNotSchoolDay: The school calendar has no lessons on this day.
attSavedToast: Register saved; some students are still unmarked
attNoStudents: No students are enrolled in this class on this day.
attNoYear: There is no school year to take registers in.
attTeacherHint: Your registers for the day. Rows start unmarked; mark the rest present in one tap.
attNoClasses: You have no classes on this day
attNoClassesBody: Registers appear here for the classes you teach.
attFamilyHint: Your child's attendance this school year, with every absence and late arrival.
attChronicNotice: Missed {missed} of school days, at or above the school's {threshold} threshold.
attNothingYet: No register has been taken yet.
attMarksHint: From every register, most recent first.
attBoardEmptyBody: Homeroom registers appear for every school day; other registers once taken.
attExcuseHint: An absence becomes excused; a late arrival keeps its mark and gains the reason.
attReportRange: Daily attendance from {from} to {to}. Chronic absence starts at {threshold} of days missed.
attReportEmptyBody: The report fills in as daily registers are taken.
attRuleRange: Enter a whole number from {low} to {high}.
attRulesHint: How long teachers may correct registers, and when absence becomes a concern.
attRuleEditDaysHint: 0 lets teachers change only today's registers. The office can always correct.
attRuleNoticeDelay: Wait before telling families, in minutes
attRuleNoticeDelayHint: An unexcused absence waits this long, so a corrected register sends no false alarm.
attRuleChronicHint: Students who miss this share of days or more are flagged in reports.
attAdminHint: Registers across the school, absences to follow up, what families report, and attendance over time.
attStale: Someone saved this register after you opened it. Reload to see their marks before saving again.
attNotRoster: A student is no longer in this class on this day. Reload the register to see the current roster.
attNoPeriod: Choose a period of this school day.
attReasonInvalid: Choose a reason from the list.
attRangeInvalid: The start date must come before the end date.
attCorrectionHint: This register was submitted. Each changed mark keeps its earlier mark, who changed it, when, and this reason.
deskNoneBody: Children arriving late or leaving early through reception appear here, and their marks reach the day's registers.
deskAskFirst: Check with the office before handing over
deskTheirNameHint: As they gave it, after checking with a contact on record.
fupCallsHint: Children away with no reason and no word from their family. Reach a family on the first day, and keep trying while the absence stays unexplained.
fupNoCalls: Nobody to call: every absence today has a reason or a family's report.
fupNoContacts: No family contact the school may call.
fupNoteHint: What the family said, or when to try again.
fupOverdueHint: Absences from before {date} still have no reason. A reason is due within five school days.
fupSupportHint: Children who have missed {percent}% of this year or more. Half or more is severe absence.
fupNoSupport: Nobody has missed enough of the year to need support
attRuleLateAfterHint: An arrival this long after a period starts is marked late, with its minutes.
attRuleClosesHint: Arrivals after this are late after the register closed. England's guidance allows 30 at most.
attRuleClosesAfterLate: The register must close after lateness starts.
repHint: Tell the school before a day your child will miss, or send a note after it. Leave asked for ahead waits for the school's answer.
repKindAbsent: Away for a day or more
repFileHint: A photo or PDF. Only the school office sees it.
repWithdrawBody: The school will no longer expect {name} to be away then.
repTooLate: Reports reach back two weeks at most. Speak to the school about anything older.
repNeedsTime: A late arrival or early leave takes a time, on one day.
repAlreadyDecided: The school has already answered this report.
repDeclineBody: The family hears that the school did not accept it, and the marks stay as the registers have them.
repDeclineHint: They read this beside the answer.
repNoneWaitingBody: Absences families report appear here for you to accept or decline.
ntfReportAccepted: The school accepted your report for {name}
ntfReportDeclined: The school did not accept your report for {name}
enrollmentRegistersAfter: Choose a day after {date}. A register on that day already marks this student in the class.
ttTimetablesHint: Each timetable is followed from its first day until the next one starts. A new one can start with the lessons of the one before it, and can repeat over A and B weeks or a cycle of days.
ttTimetablesNone: Every week is the same from the start of the year until a timetable is added.
ttTimetableFirst: From the start of the year
ttTimetableFirstHint: The year's first timetable is followed from the year's first day.
ttTimetableRemoveBody: Its lessons are removed, and the timetable before it is followed in its place.
ttTimetableStartsHint: Days before it follow the timetable before it. A new timetable starts today at the earliest.
ttTimetableStartCopy: The lessons of the timetable before it
ttCycleKindDays: Over a cycle of school days
ttCycleFirstHint: Where the cycle stands on the timetable's first school day.
ttCycleFixedHint: Lessons are placed on this cycle, so it stays. Add a timetable from a date to change it.
ttClosuresMove: Closed days keep the cycle where it was
ttClosuresMoveHint: After a holiday the cycle carries on from where it stopped. Otherwise it keeps to the calendar, and a closed day or week loses its place.
ttErrCycleInUse: Lessons are placed on this timetable's cycle. Add a timetable from a date to repeat lessons another way.

privacyLawEnglandRecord: England, a parent and the educational record

privacyRegulatorDue: The regulator must be told by {date}.
privacyRegulatorOptional: The law does not require telling the regulator.

privacyErrErasureExam: Their exam coursework must be kept until its session's date.

productFeaturesTitle: Built for how schools actually run
productFeaturesBody: Each part knows about the others, so a timetable feeds the register and a register reaches the family.
productFeatureLearningBody: Courses and lessons, assignments and quizzes, rubrics, a gradebook, standards and early-years goals.
productFeatureCodingBody: A Scratch studio, Python, p5.js and the micro:bit editor, marked and kept with each student's work.
productFeatureSchoolLifeBody: Attendance, timetables, the school year and its terms, calendars, announcements and news.
productFeatureRecordsBody: Students and families, enrolment, documents and consents, with every change recorded.
productFeatureWebsiteBody: A public website built from sections, with news, events and enquiry forms, on your own domain and in both languages.
productFeatureMessagesBody: Messages and email notifications that keep quiet hours, and acknowledgements for what families must read.
productShotQuiz: A lesson's quiz with points, answers to check and hints
productShotWebsite: A school's public website, built in Farida
productLanguagesBody: Every screen works right to left and left to right. The school writes in both languages, and each family reads in the one it chose.
productLanguagesPoint1: Each post and page written once in each language
productLanguagesPoint2: Emails sent in the reader's own language
productLanguagesPoint3: Names recorded in Arabic and in English
productLanguagesPoint4: Arabic-Indic or Western digits, as your school writes them
productTrustTitle: Your school's data stays your school's
productTrustBody: Each school's records are walled off in the database, encrypted where they are sensitive, and backed up every night.
productTrustIsolationBody: Each school's records are separated in the database itself, not only in the app.
productTrustEncryptionBody: Sensitive fields are encrypted with each school's own keys, and every connection uses HTTPS.
productTrustBackupsBody: Nightly backups to a second provider, kept where they cannot be deleted.
productTrustHistoryBody: Every change to a record is kept, with who made it and when.
productStep1Body: A short call about your classes, your year and what you use today.
productStep2Body: Your school on your own domain, with its first administrators ready to sign in.
productStep3Body: Staff, students and families each get their own sign-in by email.
productOpenBody: Farida's source is public. A school or group of schools may run it on its own server for its own people, under the Functional Source License.

auditReadingNormsReset: Reading norms set back to the defaults
prosodyExpression1: Reads as if just getting the words out, with little sense of natural speech; a quiet voice.
prosodyExpression2: Sounds natural in places but not others, still mostly saying the words; often a quiet voice.
prosodyExpression3: Sounds like natural language through most of the passage, slipping only now and then; volume generally right.
prosodyExpression4: Reads with good expression and enthusiasm throughout, matching expression and volume to the meaning.
prosodyPhrasing1: Reads in a monotone, often word by word, with little sense of where phrases end.
prosodyPhrasing2: Often reads in choppy two- and three-word groups, not marking the ends of sentences.
prosodyPhrasing3: A mixture of run-ons, pauses mid-sentence and some choppiness; reasonable stress and intonation.
prosodyPhrasing4: Generally reads in clause and sentence units, with good attention to expression.
prosodySmoothness1: Many long pauses, hesitations, false starts, sounding out and repeats.
prosodySmoothness2: Several rough spots where long pauses or hesitations break the reading.
prosodySmoothness3: Now and then breaks the rhythm over particular words or sentences.
prosodySmoothness4: Reads smoothly, quickly sorting out difficult words, usually by correcting themselves.
prosodyPace3: An uneven mixture of fast and slow.
prosodyPace4: Reads at a conversational pace throughout.
readingStaffHint: Words correct a minute in each reading a teacher marked this year, against the school's norm for the student's grade at that time of year.
readingMineHint: How many words you read correctly a minute each time your teacher marked your reading, and the words to practise.
readingNormsOwn: The school's own norms, which each student's readings are set against.
readingNormsDefaultEn: Hasbrouck and Tindal's 2017 norms for grades 1 to 6, words correct a minute. Change any figure, or add grades, to make them the school's own.
readingNormsDefaultAr: There are no published norms for reading Arabic aloud to start from. Add the grades your school measures and the words correct a minute it expects.
readingNormsEmpty: No grades yet. Add a grade and a time of year below.

readingNormsResetBodyEn: The school's own figures go, and readings are set against Hasbrouck and Tindal's 2017 norms again.
readingNormsResetBodyAr: The school's own figures go, and Arabic readings are set against no norm until new ones are written.
readingErrNormRepeated: Each grade appears once for each time of year.
